system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Hey <USER> could you PLEASE make it easier to fix tagging mistakes on releases ?? It would be so great if you could do it from your own artist profile 🙏🏼 Thank youuuuu 😘"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Thanks for your suggestion! We recommend reaching out to your distributor, as they'll work with our team to help fix any tagging issues on your artist profile. Keep us posted! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Tone is too casual and emoji use is inconsistent with professional support."}
